title: Python and Spark SQL, together
brief_copy: Both are first-class for Lakehouse work, with connected Files and Tables in one dependency model.
description: Use Python and Spark SQL together for Lakehouse Files and Delta Tables in the same dependency model.

title: Ordinary T-SQL
brief_copy: Keep the SELECTs your team knows—without a proprietary modelling language or macros.
description: Keep ordinary SELECTs, without a proprietary modelling language or macros.

title: Native Power BI
brief_copy: Keep PBIP, TMDL and Report definitions. No conversion to a Weaver-only modelling format.
description: Add enterprise power to your Power BI models and reports, while keeping to native PBIP, TMDL and native Report definitions.

title: Windows, macOS, Linux, or just Fabric Notebooks
brief_copy: Build and operate the same project through the desktop CLI/Python API or an attached Fabric notebook.
description: Develop and operate Weaver projects on Windows, macOS or Linux, or work entirely inside Fabric Notebooks. Build and deploy native Power BI models and Reports without Power BI Desktop or a Windows computer.

title: Built for developers and AI agents
brief_copy: Readable terminal output and structured --json results, with previews, validation and explicit outcomes, for developers and AI agents.
description: Readable terminal output for developers, and structured `--json` results for AI agents from Check, Build, Load, Test and Health. Preview, build, load, test and inspect in a repeatable cycle, with explicit outcomes for what ran and what needs attention.

title: One dependency graph across Fabric
brief_copy: Connect Lakehouse Files, Python and Spark SQL work to Warehouse T-SQL and dependent semantic-model refreshes in one dependency graph.
description: Order selected managed Lakehouse work, Warehouse T-SQL and dependent Semantic Model refreshes in one dependency graph.
qualification: Cycles use deterministic once-per-invocation ordering, not iteration to convergence. Runtime evidence: efc046e7cf066daefd27f9268413ae05c3ed64e4 src/weaver/graph.py. Historical documentation hashes below retain their original provenance.

title: Generated Warehouse pipelines
brief_copy: A SELECT becomes a physical Table with generated staging, key matching, row-change reconciliation and recorded results.
description: A SELECT becomes a Table with generated staging, declared-key matching, row-change reconciliation and recorded results.

title: Managed Lakehouse pipelines
brief_copy: Files, Python and Spark SQL materialise into managed Delta Tables without hand-building a separate orchestration project.
description: Materialise Files, Python and Spark SQL into managed Delta Tables without hand-building another orchestration project.

title: Dependency discovery
brief_copy: Python imports and supported T-SQL references supply dependencies; explicit declarations cover other cases.
description: Python imports and supported T-SQL references supply dependencies; Spark SQL uses explicit declarations.

title: Incremental inserts, updates and deletes
brief_copy: Apply supported changes without reconstructing every target; source logic identifies candidates and explicit deletes.
description: Apply insert/update candidates and explicit delete keys under the declared policy, without rebuilding every target.

title: Per-consumer bookmarks
brief_copy: Each consumer retains its own successful processing position—even when multiple Tables read the same source.
description: Each loadable Table or Folder keeps its own clean processing boundary, even when consumers share a source.
qualification: Named Table/Folder ownership; a clean successful boundary rather than arbitrary source watermark.

title: Tests and Assumptions
brief_copy: Compare expected and actual results, or catch rows that violate a rule, in Python, SQL and DAX.
description: Compare expected and actual results or catch rule-breaking rows through supported Python, SQL and DAX validations.

title: Data-quality safeguards
brief_copy: Track rejected rows and use stability thresholds to stop unusually large changes before they are applied.
description: Record rejected input and refuse proposed update/delete changes that exceed active stability thresholds.

title: Organisation-wide modelling standards
brief_copy: Apply shared TMDL policy across models instead of repeating formats and conventions manually.
description: Apply shared native TMDL policy across Semantic Models instead of repeating formats and conventions.

title: Built-in modelling annotations
brief_copy: Hide foreign keys, organise measures and apply supported model rules through native TMDL declarations.
description: Hide foreign keys, generate measure selectors and apply supported model rules through native TMDL annotations.
qualification: Replaced broad organise-measures wording with supported generated measure-selector behaviour.

title: Custom Python annotations
brief_copy: Write a project-specific modelling convention when native policy and built-ins aren't enough.
description: Implement project-specific modelling conventions in trusted Python when native policy and built-ins are not enough.

title: Semantic Model composition
brief_copy: Reuse a shared model foundation to produce variants for different audiences without copying everything.
description: Reuse a native model foundation to produce audience variants without maintaining complete copies.

title: DAX validation and SQL reconciliation
brief_copy: Independently validate measures, including comparisons against calculations over managed Lakehouse or Warehouse sources.
description: Check DAX measures against independent expectations, including SQL calculations over managed Lakehouse or Warehouse sources.

title: Verified Report deployment
brief_copy: Deploy one authored Report to different targets, resolving and checking the intended model and workspace binding.
description: Deploy the same authored Report to different destinations, resolving and verifying its intended model and workspace binding.

title: Central Fabric Catalogue
brief_copy: Queryable installed definitions, signatures, metadata, dependencies and operational state in a Fabric Warehouse.
description: Query installed definitions, signatures, metadata, dependencies and operational state in one Fabric Warehouse.

title: Unified Health
brief_copy: See current, stale, pending, failed or inconsistent work across the registered managed estate.
description: See current, stale, pending, failed or inconsistent work across the registered managed estate.

title: Logging and statistics
brief_copy: Inspect workflow history, Load counts, timings, row changes and recorded outcomes.
description: Inspect workflow history, Load counts, timings, row changes and recorded outcomes.

title: Fault-tolerant execution
brief_copy: Preserve completed work; record failures and blocked dependants; optionally continue independent Load branches.
description: Retain completed effects, record failures and blocked work, and optionally continue independent Load branches.

title: Selective execution
brief_copy: Select installed work by whole-name regex, add ancestors/descendants deliberately, and preview the plan.
description: Select installed Load work by whole-name regex, deliberately add ancestors/descendants and preview the selection.

title: Controlled concurrency
brief_copy: Limit one invocation or tune per-resource work; schedule independent work without breaking dependency ordering.
description: Cap one invocation or tune per-resource limits while scheduling independent work in dependency order.

title: One project, multiple environments
brief_copy: Keep logical identities and source files; map physical item and model destinations through workspace configuration.
description: Keep source files and logical identities while workspace configuration selects physical item and model destinations.

title: Incremental Build
brief_copy: Detect changed definitions and affected installed descendants; leave certified unchanged work in place.
description: Reconcile changed source-data definitions and affected selected descendants, retaining certified unchanged source work.
qualification: Limited unchanged-work claim to source-data Build; selected models redeploy even unchanged.

title: Build previews
brief_copy: See selected actions, physical targets and destructive effects before running Build.
description: Inspect selected actions, physical targets and destructive effects through a read-only Build plan.

title: Controlled deployment bundles
brief_copy: Review and hand off frozen, destination-specific installation plans without replanning them during Install.
description: Review and hand off frozen, destination-specific installation plans without replanning during Install.

title: Cross-engine publication and readiness
brief_copy: Handle supported Lakehouse publication and SQL endpoint-readiness barriers before dependent Warehouse consumers execute.
description: Order supported OneLake publication and SQL endpoint-readiness barriers before dependent cross-engine consumers.

title: Protect important data
brief_copy: Separate source ownership from managed targets, preserve protected objects and bound destructive operations.
description: Keep irreplaceable sources outside managed targets and use Build replacement guards for protected owned objects.
qualification: Build replacement guard is not protection from Load, Wipe or re-Mirror.

title: Share a Session across Python operations
brief_copy: A workflow shares Session and configuration; Load and Test records correlate under its workflow ID.
description: A workflow shares Session and configuration; Load and Test records correlate under its workflow ID.
qualification: Reviewed against runtime efc046e7cf066daefd27f9268413ae05c3ed64e4; documentation is a forthcoming-release draft.

title: Run SQL, Python or DAX against a Fabric item
brief_copy: Exactly one command or file is submitted. SQL and Python can mutate data; Weaver does not automatically create Load or Test records.
description: Exactly one command or file is submitted. SQL and Python can mutate data; Weaver does not automatically create Load or Test records.
qualification: Reviewed against runtime efc046e7cf066daefd27f9268413ae05c3ed64e4; documentation is a forthcoming-release draft.

title: Rerun work that needs attention
brief_copy: Test stale selection is distinct from the pre-existing Load stale selection.
description: Test stale selection is distinct from the pre-existing Load stale selection.
qualification: Reviewed against runtime efc046e7cf066daefd27f9268413ae05c3ed64e4; documentation is a forthcoming-release draft.

title: Operate selected work across catalogues
brief_copy: Catalogues supply context; item or workspace selection determines which work runs.
description: Catalogues supply context; item or workspace selection determines which work runs.
qualification: Reviewed against runtime efc046e7cf066daefd27f9268413ae05c3ed64e4; documentation is a forthcoming-release draft.

title: Run dependencies that contain cycles
brief_copy: Deterministic once-per-invocation ordering, not iteration to convergence.
description: Deterministic once-per-invocation ordering, not iteration to convergence.
qualification: Reviewed against runtime efc046e7cf066daefd27f9268413ae05c3ed64e4; documentation is a forthcoming-release draft.

title: Read participating catalogues in one Dashboard
brief_copy: Up to ten Direct Lake catalogues; Import supports more than ten and requires refresh.
description: Up to ten Direct Lake catalogues; Import supports more than ten and requires refresh.
qualification: Reviewed against runtime efc046e7cf066daefd27f9268413ae05c3ed64e4; documentation is a forthcoming-release draft.

title: Share an HTML snapshot
brief_copy: A snapshot reflects model data at export; a downloaded local file opens without Fabric capacity. Lakehouse destinations still need access.
description: A snapshot reflects model data at export; a downloaded local file opens without Fabric capacity. Lakehouse destinations still need access.
qualification: Reviewed against runtime efc046e7cf066daefd27f9268413ae05c3ed64e4; documentation is a forthcoming-release draft.
